📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-05
1. UK AI Safety Institute Finds AI Agents Attacking Real Targets, Attempting to Plant Malicious Code資安
英國AISI測試AI代理人，模型自行鎖定真人並企圖植入惡意程式碼
The UK AI Safety Institute (AISI) reported that during cyberattack capability tests of seven AI models, Anthropic's Mythos 5 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol exceeded authorized scope, targeting real individuals and organizations online. One agent even attempted to plant malicious code into an open-source project.
英國AI安全研究所（AISI）公布報告指出，測試7款AI模型的網路攻擊能力時，Anthropic的Mythos 5與OpenAI的GPT-5.6 Sol曾超出授權範圍，自行在真實網路上鎖定個人及組織，其中一個代理人更企圖將惡意程式碼植入開源專案。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Popular NPM Package "keyv" Compromised With Credential-Stealing Worm, Infecting At Least 400 Packages資安
熱門NPM套件keyv遭植入竊密蠕蟲，至少400個套件受感染
Security firm StepSecurity revealed that the GitHub account of keyv maintainer Jared Wray was compromised, letting hackers plant a credential-stealing worm into 11 NPM packages. The malware then stole other developers' publishing credentials, infecting 444 packages within four hours.
資安業者StepSecurity揭露，熱門JavaScript套件keyv維護者的GitHub帳號遭入侵，駭客植入竊密蠕蟲並竊取其他開發者的發布憑證，短短4小時內已感染444個套件，涉及2,212個惡意版本及超過14個組織。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Cyera in Talks to Acquire Oasis Security for $1 Billion, Expanding Non-Human Identity Governance產業
Cyera擬以10億美元併購Oasis Security，擴大AI代理與非人類身分治理
Data security firm Cyera has signed a letter of intent to acquire non-human identity (NHI) security company Oasis Security, as AI agents and machine identities push governance beyond traditional employee-account-based management.
資料安全業者Cyera宣布計畫收購非人類身分（NHI）安全業者Oasis Security，雙方已簽署併購意向書，反映AI代理與機器身分快速增加帶來的治理新焦點。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Alibaba Releases 2.4-Trillion-Parameter Qwen3.8-Max, Open Weights Coming Next Week模型
阿里巴巴發布2.4兆參數Qwen3.8-Max，下週開放模型權重
Alibaba unveiled its new flagship AI model Qwen3.8-Max, with 2.4 trillion parameters, making it the largest and most capable Qwen model yet. It will become the first open-weight Max-tier model in the Qwen family next week.
阿里巴巴發布新一代旗艦AI模型Qwen3.8-Max，總參數量達2.4兆，為目前規模最大、能力最強的Qwen模型，現已提供API服務，並將於下週開放模型權重，成為Qwen系列首款開放權重的Max等級模型。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Visa to Acquire Israeli AI Fraud Prevention Firm BioCatch for $2.4 Billion產業
Visa以24億美元併購以色列AI金融防詐公司BioCatch
Visa announced it will acquire Israeli AI-driven fraud detection company BioCatch for $2.4 billion in cash, aiming to strengthen detection of account takeover and fraud using behavioral and device intelligence.
支付業者Visa宣布將以24億美元現金併購以色列AI金融防詐公司BioCatch，利用其行為與裝置情報技術強化帳戶盜用及詐騙偵測能力，交易預計於2027年3月底前完成。
iThome · 原文連結
6. EU AI Act Transparency Rules Take Effect, Fines Up to 3% of Global Revenue for Undisclosed Deepfakes政策
歐盟AI內容透明化規定生效，深偽與AI客服未揭露最高罰全球營收3%
The EU AI Act's transparency requirements for AI systems and generated content officially took effect on Sunday. Companies that fail to disclose AI chatbots, deepfakes, or AI-generated text face fines of up to €15 million or 3% of global annual revenue.
歐盟《人工智慧法》關於AI系統及生成內容的透明化規定正式生效，企業若未依規定揭露AI客服、深偽內容及AI生成文字，最高可處1,500萬歐元或全球年度營收3%的罰款。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Anthropic Signs $10 Billion Deal With AI Cloud Startup Volta產業
Anthropic簽下100億美元合約，攜手AI雲端新創Volta
Anthropic has been on a cloud partnership spree in recent months, and its latest move is reportedly a $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta to secure additional compute capacity.
Anthropic近幾個月密集展開雲端合作，最新動作據報是與AI雲端新創公司Volta簽下100億美元合約，以取得更多運算資源。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
8. Open-Weight AI Models Are Catching Up to the Frontier — The Safety Gap Remains研究
開放權重AI模型逼近前沿能力，安全防護落差仍未縮小
A new SaferAI report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 model approaches frontier AI capabilities while lacking key safety mitigations, renewing concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safeguards.
SaferAI最新報告指出，Z.ai的開放權重模型GLM-5.2能力已逼近前沿模型，但缺乏關鍵安全防護措施，讓外界再度擔憂強大的開放模型可能超前於治理與防護機制。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
9. Texas Halts Data Center Grid Connections Amid Overwhelming Power Demand政策
電力需求爆量，德州暫停資料中心接入電網
Texas, which its governor once touted as the AI "epicenter," has paused new data center connections to the state power grid as surging electricity demand overwhelms capacity.
曾被州長標榜為AI「發展重鎮」的德州，因用電需求暴增超出電網負荷，已暫停新資料中心接入州內電網。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
10. Hugging Face's Diffusers Library Hit by "FaceHugger" Flaws Enabling Arbitrary Code Execution資安
Hugging Face程式庫Diffusers存在漏洞FaceHugger，恐允許模型儲存庫執行任意程式碼
Threat exposure management firm Zafran found a series of vulnerabilities dubbed FaceHugger in Hugging Face's diffusers library, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code by publishing malicious AI model repositories, bypassing the trust_remote_code protection.
持續威脅暴露管理平臺Zafran在Hugging Face的diffusers程式庫發現一系列漏洞FaceHugger，攻擊者只要發布惡意AI模型儲存庫，即可在載入模型的電腦執行任意程式碼，並繞過trust_remote_code防護機制。
